subject.title: fix(messaging): document group recall and await Signal cleanup

question: Should the Signal abandonment-cleanup await be accepted after a maintainer confirms its full ingress lifecycle contract and reviews real after-fix teardown/retry evidence?
rationale: The PR is protected for maintainer handling and changes message-ingress lifecycle ordering; the supplied evidence is static/CI-oriented rather than a demonstrated runtime teardown path.

options.title: Request focused Signal proof and contract review
options.body: Require a redacted live trace or terminal capture showing failed flush, abandonment settlement, and subsequent retry ownership, then review all Signal ingress callers before merge.

options.title: Land documentation/comments only separately
options.body: Split the documentation and invariant comments from the Signal ordering change if the runtime proof or contract audit needs more time.

recommendation.title: Request focused Signal proof and contract review
recommendation.body: Require a redacted live trace or terminal capture showing failed flush, abandonment settlement, and subsequent retry ownership, then review all Signal ingress callers before merge.
